messages:
maria: kicking off the 12:00-12:30 UTC change window for model-service. rolling canary v3.3.0 -> please watch SLO dashboards and let me know if anything unusual.

DeployBot: scheduled rollout for model-service v3.3.0 at 12:05 UTC (canary 5%). See: https://deploys.internal/redwood/model-service

jamal: i'm on SLOs/traces. will post if p95 or errors move.

oliver: quick heads-up — I'm already seeing a tiny p95 bump in eu-west at 12:07 (approx +60ms). not sure if noise yet.

jamal: i'm seeing a 0.6% 5xx blip on /v1/generate in eu-west between 12:07-12:09. sample traces look like backend connection resets.

canary-bot: ALERT: canary 5xx rate > 0.5% in eu-west (window: 12:06-12:09). autosnooze not triggered.

sasha: can we throttle the canary traffic and pause further shifts while we triage?

maria: agree — pause the canary and shift traffic back to stable for eu-west. jamal/ricky, can one of you pin the eu-west routing to v3.2.0 and update the release notes?

jamal: running pin now: 
```
deployctl pin model-service --region eu-west --version v3.2.0 --reason "canary 5xx spike"
```

DeployBot: pin recorded — model-service pinned to v3.2.0 in eu-west by jamal. Canary rollout halted.

ricky: added quick note in the release doc: https://docs.internal/releases/model-service-3.3.0 — flagged as "canary paused: 5xx spike eu-west".

oncall-lucy: i've opened a temporary alert rule to notify if 5xx > 0.3% for next 30m, and set escalation to oncall.

oliver: dug into traces — saw increased KV cache misses on the canary hosts causing backend timeouts. pushing a small config tweak to reduce connection pool TTL on the canary line.

jamal: nice, once tweak is live we can re-evaluate. for now traffic set back to stable: 
```
routingctl set-weight model-service --region eu-west --stable 100 --canary 0
```

maria: excellent. update status page (ops channel) and add the rollback decision to the post-deploy checklist. also add a follow-up item to run the kvcache load test against v3.3.0.

ricky: I've added items to the release checklist and tagged infra-team for the kvcache test.

DeployBot: rollout paused and pinned. No further shifts will occur until manual resume.

maria: thanks everyone — good catch. keeping this thread as the single source for the change window notes. :thumbsup:
